One number does not: '(AM26LV32EIDR adds 9 ns maximum part-to-part skew to the 50 ns quadrature spacing)' takes tsk(pp), which SLLS849E 6.6 gives as 'Pulse skew (device to device)' 9 ns max, between two devices. A and B share one package. Quadrature edges alternate rising and falling, and the datasheet bounds the delay difference between a rising edge on one channel and a falling edge on another only by the delay spread 26 - 8 = 18 ns (12 ns if tsk(o) is taken as output skew and added to tsk(p)). The spacing at 5 MHz is at least 32 ns, not 41 ns. The conclusion stands: 32 ns is above the 14 ns the model decodes.

figures.figure: re-rank report: separate receivers and the decoder
figures.evidence: The THVD part re-derives: SLLSEY3E 7.8 receiver tPHL, tPLH 25 typ / 40 max ns at CL 15 pF, no minimum; 50 - 40 = 10 ns; 1/(4 x 54 ns) = 4.63 MHz. The AM26LV32EIDR comparison does not: SLLS849E 6.6 labels tsk(o) 'Pulse skew', the same as tsk(p), and defines neither. Quadrature edges alternate direction (A rise, B rise, A fall, B fall), so a same-direction output skew does not bound a rising edge on A against a falling edge on B. By the method the figure applies to THVD (maximum minus minimum delay) the bound is 26 - 8 = 18 ns, leaving 32 ns; with tsk(o) + tsk(p) it is 12 ns, leaving 38 ns. 'leaving 44 ns' is not a datasheet bound. The conclusions stand: THVD 10 ns under 14 ns; AM26LV32E 32 ns above it.

Confirmed: TLV3201 IIB 5 nA max -40 to 125 °C (6.5); TLV3601 IB 5 µA max -40 to 125 °C (6.5); MAX999 IB ±15 µA at 25 °C, ±30 µA TMIN-TMAX (µMAX, SOT23), RIND 8 kOhm, RINCM 130 kOhm typ at 5 V, differential clamp 2.1 V at 100 µA. Two statements fail: (1) TLV3501 SBOS321E 6.6 gives IB ±10 pA max at TA 25 °C only (table 'At TA = 25°C ... unless otherwise noted', no temperature row; note 2 'Not production tested'), not a maximum over temperature. (2) 'MAX999EUK+T therefore does not work with the surrounding parts of TLV3201AIDBVR' is not derived: the divider is round 2 with no resistance anywhere, and the criterion is not applied to TLV3601DBVR, kept as rank 1's alternate with 5 µA and RDM 67 kOhm typ. With a divider Thevenin resistance R the offset is IB x R for each part; without R no stated figure separates 5 µA from 30 µA.
